name: Lomita City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, June 01, 2021 - 06:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
PURSUANT TO EXECUTIVE ORDER N-29-20 ISSUED BY GOVERNOR NEWSOM ON MARCH 17, 2020, THE PUBLIC AND COUNCIL MAY PARTICIPATE IN THIS MEETING VIA TELECONFERENCE.
Public comment will be accepted via email to ccpubliccomments@lomitacity.com prior to the meeting and before the close of oral communications. All comments will be read into the record.
The public may also participate in the meeting via a computer or smart device by logging into ZOOM at the following link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88655735632
You may enter your name when prompted do so. If you wish to provide public comment at either the beginning of the meeting or for a particular item, you may either (a) contact the City Clerk's Office before the meeting and provide your name or (b) utilize the "raise hand" option located under the participant's name. Once you click on this option you will be in the rotation to make a public comment.
Please note, if you do not have the audio feature on your device you will need to call (669) 900-6833 and enter ZOOM Meeting ID: 886 5573 5632 then press pound (#). When prompted to enter the participation ID number press pound (#) again. To make a public comment enter "*9". The Clerk's office will be notified, and you will be announced to make a public comment.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution via the City of Lomita website or by contacting the Deputy City Clerk at l.abbott@lomitacity.com.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at (310) 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
This meeting will be conducted in compliance with CDC guidelines and applicable orders of the Los Angeles County Health Officer.
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a)
Call Meeting to Order
b)
Flag Salute
c)
Invocation – Mayor Pro Tem Segawa
d)
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
* SOUTH BAY WORKFORCE INVESTMENT BOARD 3rd QUARTER REPORT PRESENTED BY CHRIS CAGLE
* PRESENTATION TO RETIRING ESHELMAN AVENUE ELEMENTARY SCHOOL TEACHERS STEVE SEAL, AND TERESA MONTES
Item 3
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five-minute time limit per person has been established. Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibits the Council from discussing or taking action on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, requests for clarification or factual information, or placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Council Member or staff.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That Consent Calendar Items 7 a-d be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Full Reading of Ordinances and that they be Read in Title Only
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Motion.
b.
Minutes of the Regular City Council Meeting of May 18, 2021
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Minutes.
Item 7b
c.
Warrants/Payroll Register
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve and file Warrants/Payroll Register.
Item 7c
d.
Resolution Approving and Authorizing Participation in the Permanent Local Housing Allocation (PLHA) Grant Program
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Resolution 2021-13 approving and authorizing participation in the Los Angeles County Permanent Local Housing Allocation (PLHA) Program by authorizing the City Manager to sign a contract for funding for this program from the County of Los Angeles once it becomes available for the PHLA Program Year 2 (2020) Allocation to implement the program in Fiscal Year 2021-2022.
RESOLUTION NO. 2021- 13 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING AND AUTHORIZING THE PARTICIPATION IN THE LOS ANGELES URBAN COUNTY PERMANENT LOCAL HOUSING ALLOCATION PROGRAM
Item 7d
SCHEDULED ITEMS
8.
DISCUSSION AND REVIEW OF CITY COUNCIL MEMBER HEALTH BENEFITS OPTIONS
Presented by Gary Sugano, Assistant City Manager
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Discuss and provide staff further direction.
Item SCH 8
9.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION TO ACCEPT THE 2020 ANNUAL PROGRESS REPORT ON THE GENERAL PLAN AND IMPLEMENTATION OF THE HOUSING ELEMENT
Presented by Greg Kapovich, Community and Economic Development Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Accept the 2020 Report on the progress of the General Plan and on the implementation of the Housing Element.
Item SCH 9
10.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION TO REAPPOINT COMMISSIONERS AND SOLICIT CANDIDATES FOR ADDITIONAL VACANCIES
Presented by Kathleen Horn Gregory, City Clerk
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Discuss and consider 1) reappointing Steven Cammarata to the Planning Commission with a term ending June 2025; 2) reappointing Bob Steinbach to the Planning Commission with a term ending June 2025; 3) reappointing Mike Cozzolino to the Public Safety Traffic Commission with a term ending June 2025; 4) reappointing Katy Tamer to the Parks and Recreation Commission with a term ending June 2025; and 5) direct staff to continue seeking qualified candidates to fill one vacancy on the Parks and Recreation Commission and one vacancy on the Public Safety and Traffic Commission.
Item SCH 10
11.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION TO APPROVE THE RELEASE OF A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL FOR A WATER MASTER PLAN AND HYDRAULIC MODEL
Presented by Carla Dillon, P.E., Public Works Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Discuss the City’s planned Water Rates Study, and the recommendation of the Water Subcommittee to postpone discussion/consideration of rates until after the completion of the Water Master Plan update; and 2) Approve the release of a Request for Proposal for a Water Master Plan and Hydraulic Model.
Item SCH 11
12.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF A LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF DEPARTMENT (LASD) PROPOSAL FOR 2021 ILLEGAL FIREWORKS SUPPRESSION ENFORCEMENT AND A RESOLUTION AMENDING THE CITY’S FINE SCHEDULE FOR ADMINISTRATIVE CITATIONS TO INCREASE THE FINE AMOUNTS FOR VIOLATION OF SECTIONS 4-16.01 AND 4-16.02 OF THE LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE
Presented by Ryan Smoot, City Manager
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Approve the Los Angeles County Sheriff Department (LASD) Proposal for 2021 Supplemental Traffic Enforcement for up to $15,000; 2) Authorize the City Manager to direct LASD to provide this Supplemental Service; and 3) Adopt Resolution 2021-14 Amending the City’s Penalty Schedule for Administrative Fines for Violations.
RESOLUTION NO. 2021-14 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE CITY’S FINE SCHEDULE FOR ADMINISTRATIVE CITATIONS TO INCREASE THE FINE AMOUNT FOR VIOLATIONS OF SECTIONS 4-16.01 AND 4-16.02 OF THE LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE

DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION TO ADOPT A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE CITY OF LOMITA’S LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT NO. 1 CHARGES FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021-2022
Presented by Carla Dillon, Public Works Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Conduct the required public hearing; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2021-15 approving the Landscape Maintenance District No. 1 assessment for FY 2021-22.
RESOLUTION NO. 2021-15 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING THE CITY OF LOMITA’S LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT NO. 1 CHARGES FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021-22

DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING AN ORDINANCE AMENDING LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE TITLE XII, CHAPTER 3, ARTICLE 1, SECTION 12.3.03, “RULES AND REGULATIONS AND TITLE XII, CHAPTER 4, “WATER CONSERVATION” (first reading)

RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Conduct a public hearing; and 2) Introduce on first reading Ordinance No. 823, an ordinance amending Lomita Municipal Code Title XII, Chapter 3, Article 1, Section 12.3.03, “Rules and Regulations Adopted” and Title XII, Chapter 4, “Water Conservation.” and finding the same exempt from CEQA.
ORDINANCE NO. 823 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE TITLE XII, CHAPTER 3, ARTICLE 1, “IN GENERAL” AND TITLE XII, CHAPTER 4, “WATER CONSERVATION AND DROUGHT MANAGEMENT PLAN” AND FINDING THE SAME EXEMPT FROM THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT
Item PH 14

DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING A WATER RULE AND REGULATIONS RESOLUTION
Presented by Carla Dillon, Public Works Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Adopt Resolution 2021-16 approving the Water Rules and Regulations.

Presented by Kathleen Horn Gregory, City Clerk
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Conduct a public hearing; and 2) Introduce on first reading Ordinance No. 824 updating the public places for posting notices.
ORDINANCE NO. 824 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING TITLE II, CHAPTER 8, SECTION 2-8-01 OF THE LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE – PUBLIC PLACES FOR POSTING NOTICES
